{{Top|leg}}
The '''Morale Initiative''' was a series of missions undertakes by [[M1-4X]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After being recruited into [[Havoc Squad]] in [[3643 BBY]], the ultra-patriotic droid set out to improve the morale of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by neutralizing several high-value Imperial targets: [[Ambassador (Sith Empire)|Ambassador]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kavos]], and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rebus (Sith Empire)|Rebus]]. After capture of Rebus and the Ambassador and the death of Lord Kavos by the hand of M1-4X, morale across Republic forces did show a statistically significant improvement.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Following the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] and the signing of the [[Zakuul–Republic treaty]], Republic command took note of the success of the Morale Initiative and reassigned M1-4X to Republic [[Press Corps]], where he could continue to increase morale of the Republic forces away from the front lines.<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Morale Initiative appears though series of companion conversation with M1-4X and is later given a formal name in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''.
